facts.statement: Velafrons is a genus of lambeosaurine hadrosaurid dinosaur that lived in Mexico during the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Velafrons (meaning "sailed forehead") is a genus of lambeosaurine hadrosaurid dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous of Mexico.

facts.statement: Fossils of Velafrons were discovered in the Cerro del Pueblo Formation near Rincon Colorado, Coahuila, dating to about 73.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Its fossils were found in the late Campanian-aged Cerro del Pueblo Formation (about 73.5 million years ago), near Rincon Colorado, Coahuila.

facts.statement: The species Velafrons coahuilensis was formally described in 2007 by Terry Gates and colleagues based on the holotype specimen CPC-59.
facts.quote: The skeleton and skull, CPC-59, was described in 2007 by American paleontologist Terry Gates and colleagues as the holotype of the new taxon Velafrons coahuilensis

facts.statement: Velafrons represents the first new genus of lambeosaurine dinosaur described from North America in more than 70 years.
facts.quote: the first new genus of lambeosaurine from North America in over 70 years.

facts.statement: The genus name Velafrons translates to "sailed forehead," referring to the animal's distinctive cranial crest.
facts.quote: The genus name combines the Spanish word vela and Latin word frons as "sailed forehead" in reference to the cranial crest

facts.statement: Velafrons was a medium-sized hadrosaur estimated to reach a length of 7.5 meters and a weight of approximately 2.5 metric tons.
facts.quote: Velafrons was a medium-sized hadrosaur, measuring 7.5 m long and weighing around 2.5 MT.

facts.statement: As a member of the Hadrosauridae family, Velafrons was a herbivore.
facts.quote: As a hadrosaurid, Velafrons would have been a herbivore.

facts.statement: Researchers interpret the Velafrons specimen as a subadult based on its size and crest anatomy, though this is based on comparisons with other species.
facts.quote: Gates and colleagues interpreted Velafrons to be a subadult individual based on absolute size and the crest anatomy

facts.statement: Velafrons belongs to the subfamily Corythosaurini.
Velafrons is classified within the dinosaur family Hadrosauridae.
Velafrons is a member of the dinosaur class Ornithischia.
The geological time range for the genus Velafrons spans from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

rejected.quote: It is known from a mostly complete skull and partial skeleton of a juvenile individual, with a bony crest on the forehead.
